description: Rijksmonumentale sluizen en stuwen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De kaart rijksmonumentale sluizen en stuwen toont watergerelateerde kunstwerken die beschermd zijn als rijksmonument. Een puntlocatie kan een enkele sluis of stuw zijn, of een sluizen- en stuwcomplex. Niet alle kunstwerken zijn nog in gebruik als waterkering. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
